      "observations": [
        "The complete two-path owned diff changes each stream completion check to reject only when status is unsuccessful and content is empty. It does not compare the status with NS_BINDING_ABORTED. Any unsuccessful status after non-empty content follows the resolve path; successful empty content also resolves.",
        "Both listeners use content ||= text, retaining the first non-empty extracted text rather than concatenating all chunks. The body conversion supplies 32768 as maxOutputLen for each chunk and strips HTML tags. Non-empty content is the accepted condition, not proof of a complete message or a particular abort cause.",
        "After awaiting completion, drag/drop conversion assigns item.descriptionText. The extraction command also assigns the description and passes the same content to the date extractor. The rejected branch calls resolve afterward, but the earlier rejection remains the settled Promise outcome. The Promise resolves with no value when accepted; content is captured outside it.",
        "The new reason comments mention observed aborts with desired content. Their example is narrower than the actual condition. The commit reports frequent coverage-build failures and no clear cause; its linked jobs/logs remain locators, not fresh reproduction or proof that all other failures are harmless.",
        "No test or assertion changes. The accepted callbacks retain the same condition despite later unrelated import/formatting/caller cleanup. The earlier locale-menu removal lesson is separate caller context, not support for a broader rule about ignoring request errors.",
        "The complete current primary description/human comments 53–56, landing 54, activity and real footer were read; the collector explicitly excludes repetitive failure robots, not unknown human gaps. The author reports NS_BINDING_ABORTED after content arrived in coverage tests and says the cause is unclear. Later similar failure discussion is expressly moved to Bug2024842 as a different issue, not proof that this fix regressed.",
        "The full own D276809 timeline was read with zero actual inlines or summary edits. The reviewer is unsure whether the failure occurs outside automation and requests the same change in calendar-dnd-listener.js. Exact owned source adopts that second path. Approval and remote completions do not establish a fresh extraction or drag/drop result.",
        "The source condition remains broader than the abort example: failed status is tolerated whenever content is non-empty, while failed empty content rejects. Neither the human explanation nor acceptance supplies a direct test for each error status or complete-message content."

      "observations": [
        "The complete owned diff adds a preference-and-EWS branch which exposes the OAuth2 authentication menu item without provider lookup. It reads experimental.mail.ews.overrideOAuth.enabled with a false fallback and requires incoming.type == ews. This changes option visibility, not token acquisition or a completed account setup.",
        "Without that original pref/type combination, the old host-based provider lookup remains and controls visibility. Known providers can still expose OAuth with the customization preference off. Other protocols do not gain an unrestricted provider bypass from this patch.",
        "The accepted method uses config.isExchangeConfig instead of the original exact EWS test; the preserved accepted AccountConfig helper includes Graph only under its own Graph preference. That broader later phase is separate from the original EWS-only gate. Exact prior 4230 proof objects are reused unchanged rather than rereading the whole setup family.",
        "The accepted fallback reads sanitized current hostname/endpoint inputs, catches invalid input and hides OAuth when no provider is found. It also resets an already selected OAuth method to Normal Password when neither customization nor provider lookup permits it. Those later input/reset contracts are not credited to this visibility-only original patch.",
        "The checked current event callers refresh visibility after hostname input, protocol change and Exchange URL input; updateFields also supplies a config. The source comment explains the customization option, while the method summary still emphasizes known hostnames. Neither sentence makes the option globally available for every account type.",
        "No test or assertion changes. Backend custom issuer/client handling, provider registration and live OAuth requests are not traced anew. Existing manual Graph classification knowledge is reused only for the exact accepted predicate; no global provider-validation bypass is inferred.",
        "The complete primary Bug2003842 description/comments 0–2, activity and footer and own D274996 full timeline with all four actual inline bodies were read. The primary explicitly links unknown-provider visibility to the EWS custom-OAuth preference and later fully manual setup. It does not establish working custom credentials or provider auto-discovery.",
        "The author explains that two other versions of the helper serve non-Exchange configuration and should not be changed. This is retained scoped rationale, not an independent survey of every duplicate or a blanket provider-check bypass. The linked Searchfox/Try and broader Bug1780765 remain unopened dependencies.",
        "The reviewer asks whether Graph should qualify while the manual Graph patch is backed out. The author makes isExchangeConfig adoption depend on landing order. Exact original source here still tests incoming.type == ews; exact accepted source later uses isExchangeConfig. That conditional proposal and later adoption remain distinct from inline Done/NotDone labels.",
        "The accepted current-input sanitization and fallback-auth reset are also later source contracts, not changes in this original visibility patch. The review calls this a first step. No preference, account setup or OAuth request was executed."
